label: Diagram 12
caption: Diagram 12 Material change of use: fire protection of chimneys passing through other dwellings
description: The drawing is a plan view. A vertical wall is shown with diagonal hatching, its top and bottom edges cut off by wavy break lines. Near the centre of the wall is a pair of concentric circles, representing a chimney in plan. On the right-hand side of the wall a rectangular notch is cut out, which is filled by a grey shaded rectangle. To the right of this grey rectangle, horizontal dashed lines extend from the top and bottom right corners, joined by a vertical dashed line on the right, forming a larger rectangle. A thin leader line runs from a small solid black dot placed at the top-right corner of the grey rectangle to a block of text on the right, which reads: "To maintain the compartmentation of dwellings, additional fire protection may be needed to meet the Requirements in Part B". A title banner above the drawing reads: "Diagram 12 Material change of use: fire protection of chimneys passing through other dwellings".
